question: Show me the top crypto tokens that are at a 52-week high right now.
result_summary: Returned 60 results (capped=true). All tickers are .CC crypto format (ADOGE-USD.CC, ADZ-USD.CC, AIDOGE-USD.CC, AMB-USD.CC, etc.), confirming crypto-only universe. Signal matched as 'at_new_high' with strength=1.0, value=2026-08-30 for most. Notable: ADOGE-USD.CC shows RSI=7.99 while firing at_new_high — this is an inconsistency (deeply oversold RSI but claimed to be at 52-week high), suggesting possible stale/thin price data for some micro-cap tokens. Major tokens (ADZ, AIDOGE, BABYDOGE) have RSI values of 96-100 which are consistent with new highs.
reason: Crypto-only universe confirmed (.CC tickers), at_new_high pattern correctly applied, results span crypto tokens. Accepts minor data quality issues on thin micro-cap tokens.

defects.desc: Some crypto tokens fire 'at_new_high' with very low RSI (e.g. ADOGE-USD.CC RSI=7.99) suggesting thin/stale price series where a single outlier bar triggers the 52-week high signal without momentum confirmation. No warning is surfaced to the client about data quality on micro-cap tokens.
